tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List every AI coding tool QuotaTick tracks (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot …) with its current usage-limit reset status: last reset time (UTC), hours since, number of resets in the last 30 days, and the statistical chance of a reset in the next 24 hours. tools.name: get_reset_status
tools.description: Answer "did <tool> reset its usage limits today?" for one AI coding tool: whether a reset happened in the last 24 hours, the last reset time (UTC), hours since, the estimated probability of a reset in the next 24 hours, and a link to the live page with the official source.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List recent events for AI coding tools, newest first, each with its official source link: usage-limit resets, promotions and free credits, limit increases or decreases, and discontinued plans. Optionally filter by tool and by group.
